name: Memphis phonk shuffle
desc: Phonk drums off a dusty SP-12: halftime 808-kick pattern with the snare cracking on three, hats shuffled by triplet elongation like a warped Three 6 Mafia cassette, low-passed and shaped for tape grit. Peak double-times the hats and stutters the kick. Menacing cruiser tempo.

code.full: stack(s("bd ~ ~ [~ bd] ~ ~ ~ ~").bank("EmuSP12").gain(${gain}).shape(.45), s("~ ~ ~ ~ sd ~ ~ ~").bank("EmuSP12").gain(${gain}*.7).room(.22), s("[hh@2 hh]*4").bank("RolandTR808").gain("[.34 .2]*4").lpf(${dust}), s("~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ <~ ~ ~ [sd sd]>").bank("EmuSP12").gain(${gain}*.4)).lastOf(8, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(1).play()
code.peak: stack(s("<[bd ~ ~ [~ bd] ~ ~ ~ ~] [bd ~ [bd bd] ~ ~ ~ ~ ~]>").bank("EmuSP12").gain(${gain}).shape(.5), s("~ ~ ~ ~ sd ~ ~ ~").bank("EmuSP12").gain(${gain}*.75).room(.22), s("[hh hh]*4").bank("RolandTR808").gain("[.38 .24]*4").lpf(${dust}), s("~ ~ oh ~ ~ ~ oh ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(.25).lpf(${dust}), s("~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ [sd sd]").bank("EmuSP12").gain(${gain}*.45)).lastOf(4, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(1).play()
